body: Fixed in a3e3944e1. loadInputs now records missing/malformed JSON diagnostics, normalizeInputs validates expected file shapes, malformed entries are skipped, and the source document registry is validated through its registry array shape.

Fixed in a3e3944e1. The validator now receives input diagnostics, includes a no_input_diagnostics check, and fails validator.ok / validation_status when missing or malformed inputs produce error diagnostics.

Fixed in a3e3944e1. Generated candidate rows are now sorted with a null-safe natural comparator by question_key/question_ref/receipt id, and refs are built from the sorted candidate rows so source_ref json_pointer values stay aligned.
Fixed in a3e3944e1. Added focused fail-closed tests for missing required input files, malformed file shapes, malformed row skipping, and sorted ref pointer alignment. The focused suite now passes.
